ProgramUnit.Name: GET_PROPERTIES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE get_properties (field_name1 IN varchar2, no_entry OUT number,
 r_chk OUT varchar2, f_chk OUT varchar2) IS
 F_required varchar2(1);
 f_double number; 
 F_func varchar2(1); 
begin
 
 select required, no_of_entries , function_check
 into f_required, f_double , f_func
 from find_donor_fields
 where program_name = :banner.prog_name and
 field_name = field_name1;
 if f_required = 'Y' then
 nullchk; check_package_failure;
 end if;
 no_entry := f_double;
 r_chk := F_required;
 F_chk := f_func;
 
exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('9206');
 check_package_failure;
END;

PROCEDURE SET_NAVIGATION (F_NAME IN VARCHAR2,FLG IN VARCHAR2) IS
BEGIN

 set_item_property(F_NAME,NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 ELSE

 set_item_property(F_NAME,ENABLED,PROPERTY_false);
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: AUDIT_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE audit_details IS
 v_user VARCHAR2(10);
 temp_unit_chk_digit VARCHAR2(5);
 v_local_time date;
BEGIN
 
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_tran_id := :parameter.p_trans_id;
--'TR00094771';
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_unit_in_def := :parameter.p_unit_id;
--'4966728';

 If length(:ctrl_blk_1.s_unit_in_def) = 13 then
 validate_unit_chkdigit ( :ctrl_blk_1.s_unit_in_def, temp_unit_chk_digit) ;
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_unit_in_def := :ctrl_blk_1.s_unit_in_def || temp_unit_chk_digit;
 End if; 
 
 Begin
 select donor_signature_flag, --n_audit_flag, -- Modified audit flag to donor_signature_flag ;05/28/2011; AV; IM:5670
 donation_type,procedure_code,
 n_audit_date,n_audit_user 
 into :ctrl_blk_1.s_sig_flag,
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_don_type, :ctrl_blk_1.s_proc_code,
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_audit_date,v_user 
 from donations 
 where transaction_id=:ctrl_blk_1.s_tran_id;
 
 if is_timezone_enabled then -- Jairam added per IM 5326 on 25-apr-2011
 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, :ctrl_blk_1.s_audit_date, :ctrl_blk_1.s_audit_date); 
 
 else
 NULL;
 end if; 
 
 
 Exception when others then
 null;
 End;
 
 begin /* to pickup the audit username */
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_audit_user:=null;
 select user_last_name||', '||user_first_name into :ctrl_blk_1.s_audit_user 
 from system_users where user_id=v_user;
 exception when no_data_found then
 null; ---handle_error;
 end ;

 go_block('physical_findings');
 :system.message_level:=10;
 execute_query;
 :system.message_level:=0;

 /* SCR 20609; 09/15/2014; V08
 go_block('health_history');

 :system.message_level:=10;
 execute_query;
 :system.message_level:=0;
 */ 
 -- SCR 20609; 09/15/2014; V08
 DECLARE
 CURSOR hh_blk_cur IS
 SELECT hht.question_code, hht.sort_sequence, hh.response, 
 hh.answer_code, vha.answer_desc, hh.start_date,hh.end_date,
 hh.incident_date, hh.def_thru_date, 
 hh.comments, hh.inter_code -- IM 212
 FROM health_history hh, health_history_template hht, valid_hh_answers vha
 WHERE hh.template_id = hht.template_id
 AND hh.question_code = hht.question_code
 AND hh.question_code = vha.question_code(+)
 AND hh.answer_code = vha.answer_code(+)
 AND hh.transaction_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_tran_id
 ORDER BY display_order; -- IM 212 --TO_NUMBER(hht.sort_sequence); --IM 212 
 
 cntr NUMBER; 
 BEGIN
 --CLEAR_BLOCK('CTRL_HEALTH_HISTORY');
 GO_BLOCK('CTRL_HEALTH_HISTORY');
 cntr := 1;
 FOR hh_blk_rec IN hh_blk_cur LOOP
 IF cntr = 1 THEN
 FIRST_RECORD;
 ELSE
 NEXT_RECORD;
 END IF;
 :CTRL_HEALTH_HISTORY.QUESTION_CODE := hh_blk_rec.question_code;
 :CTRL_HEALTH_HISTORY.RESPONSE := hh_blk_rec.response;
 :CTRL_HEALTH_HISTORY.ANSWER_CODE := hh_blk_rec.answer_code;
 :CTRL_HEALTH_HISTORY.S_ANS_DESC := hh_blk_rec.answer_desc;
 :CTRL_HEALTH_HISTORY.S_START_DATE := hh_blk_rec.start_date;
 :CTRL_HEALTH_HISTORY.S_END_DATE := hh_blk_rec.end_date;
 :CTRL_HEALTH_HISTORY.INCIDENT_DATE := hh_blk_rec.incident_date;
 :CTRL_HEALTH_HISTORY.DEF_THRU_DATE := hh_blk_rec.def_thru_date; 
 :CTRL_HEALTH_HISTORY.comments := hh_blk_rec.comments; -- IM 212
 :CTRL_HEALTH_HISTORY.inter_code := hh_blk_rec.inter_code; -- IM 212
 cntr := cntr+1;
 END LOOP;
 
 FIRST_RECORD; 
 END;

 IF aDHQ_administered THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('ctrl_blk_1.abbr_prompt', VISIBLE, PROPERTY_TRUE);
 END IF;
 --- End Change;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ADHQ_ADMINISTERED
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION aDHQ_administered RETURN BOOLEAN IS
/* Returns TRUE if aDHQ is administered else FALSE */
 CURSOR adhq_cur IS
 SELECT 1
 FROM donor_hhq_history
 WHERE transaction_id = :CTRL_BLK_1.S_TRAN_ID
 AND actual_af_qtype = 'A';
 
 l_dummy PLS_INTEGER;
 l_rec_fnd BOOLEAN;
BEGIN
 OPEN adhq_cur;
 FETCH adhq_cur INTO l_dummy;
 l_rec_fnd := adhq_cur%FOUND;
 CLOSE adhq_cur;
 
 RETURN l_rec_fnd;
END;
